working_definition: Male germ cells at the transition between late proliferating spermatogonia and early primary spermatocytes in the adult testis; authors assign FBbt:00004936 spermatocyte.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Male germline cell that is part of the 16-cell spermatocyte cyst. It expresses twine, which regulates the meiotic cycle (Witt et al., 2019).

justification: Authors' FBbt id kept (not obsolete, cell term, no adult variant). The label names a transitional state with no FBbt term; spermatocyte is the authors' committed level.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Male germline cell found in the spermatogonial cyst. It specifically expresses bag of marbles (bam), which is required for its differentiation (Witt et al., 2019).
